title: Hoolaare Aranndeere Taƴnde Aljanna
intro: Imagine daraade e nder jarne jam timmuɗo, teddinaaɗo dow tagoore fof, keeri gooto tan ina teddiniree. Wuurde ina foda haa abada, suɓngo wooto ina wayla huunde fof, tee yurmeende ina uddita laawol ruttaade. Hol kaaloowo gila e fuɗɗoode neɗɗaagu?
clues: Miin ko Alla tagi mi e loopal, mi fawi mi e toppitagol Alla.
Mi teddinaama nde Alla yamiri maleykaaji ɗi yo cujjan mi.
Miɗo hoɗi e Aljanna e jom suudu am, miɗo weltii e kala ko wonaa lekki gooto.
Mi foolaama e ɓuuɓri Seyɗaane hunninooɗo wonde wasiyaajo laaɓɗo.
Mi nyaami lekki harminaaki, 6uu6ol am ittaama e hersa.
Mi janngii konnguɗi tuubgol e joom am, Alla ruttitii kam e yurmeende.

arabic: قَالَا رَبَّنَا ظَلَمْنَآ أَنفُسَنَا وَإِن لَّمْ تَغْفِرْ لَنَا وَتَرْحَمْنَا لَنَكُونَنَّ مِنَ ٱلْخَـٰسِرِينَ
verse: They said, "Our Lord, we have wronged ourselves, and if You do not forgive us and have mercy upon us, we will surely be among the losers." (7:23)
